evals.name: add_prospector_to_totem_west_yml
evals.prompt: I want to add a Prospector dongle to my TOTEM ZMK config at /home/olion/zmk-config-totem. Show me the updated config/west.yml that adds the prospector-zmk-module from carrefinho. The existing west.yml already has zmk-helpers from urob. Preserve that. Tell me which revision to use for prospector-zmk-module given that my zmk project pins to revision 'main' (current development).
evals.expected_output: Updated west.yml with the carrefinho remote and prospector-zmk-module project added alongside the existing zmkfirmware + urob entries. A note about branch choice (main branch tracks Zephyr 3.5 / ZMK v0.3; for newer ZMK on main, use the newer-Zephyr branch documented in the module README).
expectations: Adds a `carrefinho` remote with url-base https://github.com/carrefinho
Adds a `prospector-zmk-module` project entry referencing the carrefinho remote
Preserves the existing `zmkfirmware` remote and the `urob` remote
Preserves the existing `zmk` and `zmk-helpers` projects unchanged
Calls out that the module's `main` branch targets ZMK v0.3 / Zephyr 3.5 and that the user's `main` ZMK revision requires the `feat/new-status-screens` branch (Zephyr 4.1)
If proposing a revision value, picks `feat/new-status-screens` (not `main`) for ZMK main / Zephyr 4.1 users
Does not break the existing `self: path: config` block
Does not invent module paths or revisions that aren't supported (e.g., does not pin to a random commit SHA)

evals.name: create_totem_dongle_shield
evals.prompt: Create the totem_dongle shield for my ZMK config so it can host a Prospector dongle. The existing shield lives at /home/olion/zmk-config-totem/config/boards/shields/totem/ with totem.dtsi (defining default_transform with 10 columns / 4 rows and the RC() map), totem-layouts.dtsi (defining physical_layout0), Kconfig.shield (SHIELD_TOTEM_LEFT + SHIELD_TOTEM_RIGHT), and Kconfig.defconfig (sets central role for SHIELD_TOTEM_LEFT). Generate the three files I need: the updated Kconfig.shield (add the new dongle symbol), the updated Kconfig.defconfig (add the dongle's role + BT config), and a new totem_dongle.overlay file with mock_kscan + matrix transform copied from totem.dtsi.
evals.expected_output: Three file contents: updated Kconfig.shield, updated Kconfig.defconfig, and a new totem_dongle.overlay. The overlay must include the mock_kscan node, the default_transform copied from totem.dtsi (10 cols, 4 rows, same RC() map), the physical_layout binding via &physical_layout0, and the chosen { zmk,kscan = &mock_kscan; zmk,physical-layout = &physical_layout0; } block.
expectations: Kconfig.shield adds `config SHIELD_TOTEM_DONGLE` with `def_bool $(shields_list_contains,totem_dongle)`
Kconfig.shield preserves the existing SHIELD_TOTEM_LEFT and SHIELD_TOTEM_RIGHT entries
Kconfig.defconfig adds an `if SHIELD_TOTEM_DONGLE ... endif` block
The dongle block sets `ZMK_SPLIT_ROLE_CENTRAL default y`
The dongle block sets `ZMK_SPLIT_BLE_CENTRAL_PERIPHERALS default 1` (TOTEM is a 2-half split, so one peripheral)
The dongle block sets `BT_MAX_CONN` and `BT_MAX_PAIRED` to the same value, at least 6
Kconfig.defconfig preserves the existing SHIELD_TOTEM_LEFT central-role block (does NOT delete or disable it)
totem_dongle.overlay defines a `mock_kscan` node with `compatible = "zmk,kscan-mock"` (note the hyphen, not underscore)
totem_dongle.overlay includes the matrix transform copied from totem.dtsi — 10 columns, 4 rows, same RC() map structure
totem_dongle.overlay sets `chosen { zmk,kscan = &mock_kscan; zmk,physical-layout = &physical_layout0; }`
totem_dongle.overlay does NOT include totem.dtsi directly (which would also pull in the GPIO kscan and conflict with mock_kscan)
totem_dongle.overlay DOES include the layouts file or otherwise binds &physical_layout0 to &default_transform

evals.name: update_build_yaml_for_dongle
evals.prompt: Update my build.yaml at /home/olion/zmk-config-totem/build.yaml so that the new totem_dongle shield builds (with prospector_adapter from the prospector-zmk-module), settings_reset is available for clearing pairings, and the existing totem_left build switches from central to peripheral. The existing build.yaml currently has totem_left (with studio-rpc-usb-uart snippet) and totem_right entries, both on board: xiao_ble. The dongle should use seeeduino_xiao_ble (XIAO nRF52840). I'd like ZMK Studio to be reachable through the dongle, not the left half anymore. Show the full updated build.yaml.
evals.expected_output: An updated build.yaml that: (1) adds a totem_dongle row combining totem_dongle and prospector_adapter shields on board seeeduino_xiao_ble with the studio-rpc-usb-uart snippet, (2) adds a settings_reset row on seeeduino_xiao_ble, (3) modifies the existing totem_left row to remove the studio snippet and add cmake-args demoting central to n, (4) leaves totem_right unchanged.
expectations: Adds a new build row with `board: seeeduino_xiao_ble` and `shield: totem_dongle prospector_adapter` (both shields in the same string)
The dongle row has `snippet: studio-rpc-usb-uart` so ZMK Studio reaches the central via the dongle's USB
Adds a `settings_reset` row on `board: seeeduino_xiao_ble`
Existing `totem_left` row no longer has the `studio-rpc-usb-uart` snippet (moved to the dongle)
Existing `totem_left` row has `cmake-args: -DCONFIG_ZMK_SPLIT_ROLE_CENTRAL=n` so the half builds as a peripheral
Existing `totem_right` row is unchanged
The board for the halves stays `xiao_ble` (matches their original build); only the dongle uses `seeeduino_xiao_ble`
The output is a syntactically valid build.yaml (YAML list under `include:`)

If the user is on ZMK main / Zephyr 4.1 (not v0.3), the dongle board target is `xiao_ble/nrf52840/zmk` — the full HW V2 form, NOT the shorthand `xiao_ble//zmk` from the module README (which the Zephyr 4.1 board loader rejects locally)

For ZMK main / Zephyr 4.1, the peripheral halves (totem_left, totem_right) MUST also use `board: xiao_ble/nrf52840/zmk`, NOT plain `xiao_ble`. The plain board does not activate CONFIG_ZMK_BLE, so peripherals would build without a BLE stack and never advertise.

evals.name: debug_layer_indicator_shows_numbers
evals.prompt: My Prospector dongle for my TOTEM is working — display lights up, peripheral battery shows, but the layer indicator always shows a number (0, 1, 2, 3) instead of a name. I want it to show 'Base', 'Nav', 'Sym', 'Device'. Where do I add the layer names and which file is the source of truth? The active keymap is at /home/olion/zmk-config-totem/config/totem.keymap. Also tell me — once I add display-name properties, does the dongle pick that up automatically on the next flash, or do I need to flash both halves too?
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis: Prospector's layer widget reads each layer's `display-name` property; layers without it fall back to the index. Fix: add `display-name = "Base";` (etc.) to each layer node in config/totem.keymap. Plus: only the dongle needs reflashing — the central is what reports the active layer; peripherals don't participate in display state.
expectations: Identifies that the cause is missing `display-name` properties on each layer node
Shows the exact syntax: `display-name = "Base";` inside each layer block in the keymap
Suggests adding display-name to all four layers (base, nav_num, sym_func, device) with reasonable short labels
Recommends names short enough to render on the round LCD (≤ ~8 characters)
Mentions `CONFIG_PROSPECTOR_LAYER_ROLLER_ALL_CAPS` as an option if the user wants forced uppercase
Correctly explains that only the dongle needs reflashing for the display name change to take effect (the central is what reports active layer state)
Does NOT recommend flashing the peripherals for this fix
Does NOT recommend modifying the prospector-zmk-module source
